notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q25173_titanic.py, tools/meshkit.py) with AI assistance. Bow section (~143 m) upright, ploughed into a mud ridge, funnels gone, foremast fallen over the bridge; stern section (~109 m) collapsed about 600 m to the south, facing the opposite way; debris field with five boilers near the stern. Headings are approximate (bow roughly north).
